label: accessible via
type: the subject service/feature can be reached through the named client interface - a positive statement of an access surface. The counterpart to the already-promoted incompatibleWithAccessSurface (a negative, statement of a surface that does NOT work) - kept as two separate predicates rather than one signed relation, since a page rarely enumerates both the working and non-working surfaces together.
evidence: You can run queries using the Analytics Workbench, the command line query tool cbq, or directly through the REST API.
The Search Service can be accessed by means of the search functions provided by SQL++ — which provides the principal interface to the Query and Index Services.
relates_to_competency_question: Through which client surfaces can a given service actually be reached?
